item.title: Processing Motion Picture Film in Black White
item.description: KODAK Vision3 500T is a powerful film capable of delivering crisp results despite it’s higher ISO. Can you develop Vision3 500T in B&W? Is processing 500T in black and white worth it? Processing 500T 500T is meant to be processed in ECN-2, but you can process it like a black & white negative too. Keep in mind that using black & white developer and fixer means you are effectively bleach-bypassing your images hence producing a more contrasty look which is usually not associated with motion picture films.
